idea-plugin.name: JASX
idea-plugin.description:
Support for JASX: Java source files (.jasx) with JSX-style markup.

  • Highlighting of Java, markup and style blocks.
  • JASX errors while typing, and javac errors on save once the project is built with the JASX Gradle or Maven plugin.
  • Completion of tags, attributes and props in markup, and of Java members and names in Java code.
  • Go to definition and hover on components.

Everything but highlighting comes from the JASX language server, which runs on the IDE's own Java runtime.
